name: AllDebrid API
description:
An OpenAPI 3.1 description of the [AllDebrid](https://alldebrid.com) API v4 / v4.1,
maintained by the [open-alldebrid](https://github.com/pierre-emmanuelJ/open-alldebrid)
project and checked against the live API.

## Versions

Most endpoints live under `/v4/`. Three endpoints were bumped to `/v4.1/`
(`/pin/get`, `/user/hosts` and `/magnet/status`); their `/v4/` versions are
deprecated or discontinued and are not described here.

## Authentication

Authenticated endpoints need an API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <apikey>`.
Users create keys in their [API key dashboard](https://alldebrid.com/apikeys/),
or an application obtains one with the PIN flow:

1. `GET /v4.1/pin/get` returns a `pin` and a `check` token.
2. Show the `pin` (or `user_url`) to the user, who confirms it on alldebrid.com.
3. Poll `POST /v4/pin/check` every 5 seconds until `activated` is `true`
   and an `apikey` is returned. The PIN expires after 600 seconds.

When a key is used from a new location, the API may answer `AUTH_BLOCKED`
with a verification `token` in the error object. Poll `POST /v4/user/verif`
with that token until the user approves the login from the email they received.

## Response envelope

Every response is a JSON object with a `status` of `success` or `error`.
On success the payload is in `data`; on failure `error` holds a `code`
and a `message`. **Errors are returned with HTTP 200**: only unknown endpoints
answer 404, and rate limiting answers 429 or 503. Always check `status`.

Deprecated endpoints add `"deprecated": true`; responses produced with a
demo key add `"demo": true`.

## Demo keys

These public keys return static sample data and never touch a real account:

| Key                    | Account      |
|------------------------|--------------|
| `staticDemoApikeyPrem` | Premium user |
| `staticDemoApikeyTria` | Trial user   |
| `staticDemoApikeyFree` | Free user    |

## Rate limits

12 requests per second and 600 requests per minute per key. Cache the
`/v4/hosts*` endpoints for a few hours.

## Request encoding

POST endpoints take `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` bodies (or
`multipart/form-data`). List parameters use PHP-style names: send
`magnets[]=a&magnets[]=b`.
